# Now go through all subcommand .go files \(non-test\) and apply replacements
base = "pkg/cmd"
count = 0
for fpath in sorted\(glob.glob\(f"{base}/**/*.go", recursive=True\)\):
    if fpath.endswith\("_test.go"\):
        continue
    with open\(fpath\) as f:
        content = f.read\(\)
    
    modified = False
    for eng, chn in replacements.items\(\):
        # Match: Short: "text" or Short: `text` with various indentation
        # We need to be careful to only match exact text
        for q in ['"', '`']:
            old = f': {q}{eng}{q}'
            new = f': {q}{chn}{q}'
            if old in content:
                content = content.replace\(old, new\)
                modified = True
                count += 1
                break
    
    if modified:
        with open\(fpath, 'w'\) as f:
            f.write\(content\)

print\(f"Total replacements: {count}"\)

remaining = 0
for fpath in sorted\(glob.glob\(f"{base}/**/*.go", recursive=True\)\):
    if fpath.endswith\("_test.go"\):
        continue
    with open\(fpath\) as f:
        for line in f:
            s = line.strip\(\)
            if s.startswith\("Short:"\):
                for q in ['"', '`']:
                    prefix = f"Short: {q}"
                    if s.startswith\(prefix\):
                        text = s[len\(prefix\):s.rindex\(q\)]
                        has_chinese = any\('\\u4e00' <= c <= '\\u9fff' for c in text\)
                        if not has_chinese and len\(text\) > 3:
                            remaining += 1
print\(f"Remaining English Short descriptions: {remaining}"\)
